professional_summary: Early-career Software Engineer pursuing an M.S. in Software Engineering with a B.S. in Computer Science from Colorado School of Mines. Experience developing software in C++, C, Java, and Python with emphasis on object-oriented programming, data structures, programming languages, software architecture, automated testing, and CI/CD. Hands-on experience with Git/GitHub, GitLab, Linux, Docker, and debugging, with experience developing and testing software components and collaborating across technical and non-technical teams.
